title: Life, auto, or home insurance policy comparison
description: Normalize and compare insurance policy quotes on price and coverage gaps, then score overall value and fit.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: insurance-policy-comparison
  title: Life, auto, or home insurance policy comparison
  description: Normalize and compare insurance policy quotes on price and coverage gaps, then score overall value and fit.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Help a family compare life, auto, or home insurance policy options on price and coverage, and produce a value/fit score with clear reasoning, as general informational research rather than financial advice.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Policy quotes and family requirements
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The policy quotes or documents to compare, plus the family's coverage needs and budget. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: normalize-terms
      kind: transform
      name: Normalize policy terms
      config: { operation: select, expression: "extract premium, deductible, coverage limits, exclusions, and term length into comparable fields per policy" }
    - id: price-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Price analyst
      role: Careful, non-advisory analyst of insurance pricing.
      prompt: Compare the normalized premiums, deductibles, and fees across the policies. State plainly that this is general informational research only, not financial advice, and recommend the family confirm final numbers with a licensed insurance advisor before purchasing. Summarize which policy is cheapest under which assumptions.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, finance-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: coverage-gap-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Coverage-gap analyst
      role: Careful, non-advisory analyst of insurance coverage gaps.
      prompt: Compare the normalized coverage limits and exclusions across the policies against the family's stated needs. State plainly that this is general informational research only, not financial advice, and recommend the family confirm coverage adequacy with a licensed insurance advisor before purchasing. List any gaps or exclusions that could matter to this family.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, risk-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: compare-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel price and coverage comparison
      config: { members: [price-analyst, coverage-gap-analyst], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: merge-findings
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge price and coverage findings
      config: { aggregation: merge }
    - id: value-fit-score
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Value and fit score
      role: Independent evaluator of overall policy value and fit.
      prompt: Using the merged price and coverage findings, score how well each policy fits the family's stated needs and budget. This is general informational research only, not financial advice; recommend the family confirm the final choice with a licensed insurance advisor. Return score, passed, and reasons.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.7 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Policy comparison and value/fit score
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: normalize-terms, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: normalize-terms, to: compare-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: compare-group, to: merge-findings, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: merge-findings, to: value-fit-score, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: value-fit-score, to: result, kind: data }
